sloka: यत्त्वया करुणम् कर्म व्यपोह्य मम बान्धवाः ।निरस्ता परिधावन्ति सुखार्हः कृपणा वने ॥२-६१-१०॥
transliteration: yattvayā karuṇam karma vyapohya mama bāndhavāḥ ।nirastā paridhāvanti sukhārhaḥ kṛpaṇā vane ॥2-61-10॥

translations.english: (O king) It is because of your heartless action, my Rama and my relatives who deserve to enjoy pleasures at this age have been banished and are miserably wandering in wilderness.
